structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a busy open-plan office tower in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant clipboard checklist standing on its roof (ticks only, no words).
character: young project management intern (a mixed-race woman in her early 20s, braids in a high bun, green shirt, laptop under her arm)
scenes: she leads a short stand-up meeting with three colleagues around a tall table, holding a coffee.
she updates a large wall board with sticky notes moving between three columns.
she reviews a laptop showing an abstract timeline with coloured bars (a Gantt shape).
she flags a red sticky note to a colleague, the two of them pointing at a calendar.
she types a short update at her desk, a small tick and envelope floating above; dusk through the window.
props: a giant hourglass, a calendar, a flag on a mountain, cogs, a checklist, sticky notes, arrows joining in a loop
